notes.title: Challenge Mode Added to the Chain Letter Demo 🎯
notes.notes:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45676645/367363bfb126fa0eb404d677f666eb09422c5e4f.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Hello!
We’ve just added a brand-new [b]Challenge Mode[/b]! 🎉[/p][p]In Challenge Mode, you can:
✨ Try out [b]classmates and skills[/b] that were locked in the demo
🔥 Take on [b]two types of bosses[/b] in [b]Time Attack[/b] and [b]Kill Count[/b] rankings![/p][p]⚠ [b]Watch out for the difficulty![/b] It’s perfect for testing your skills :)[/p]

notes.title: 📢 Chain Letter Demo v0.2 Update!
notes.notes:
[h2]📢 Chain Letter Demo v0.2 Update! [/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45676645/e4d8ca39dcb4371f5391735b498deb2cee0207bb.png"][/img][/p][h2][/h2][p][/p][p]Hi there! I'm Moogugoo, the developer of [b]Chain Letter[/b].[/p][p]The demo has returned with big improvements in version 0.2![/p][p]Here’s what’s new in this update:[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]🎨 [b]Character Art Renewal[/b]
The main character and NPCs have received a complete visual update.[/p][p]🎬 [b]Intro Overhaul[/b]
You can now jump right into combat — no more waiting![/p][p]🛒 [b]Steam Store Page Update[/b]
The store visuals have been refreshed to match the new art style.[/p][p]🎁 [b]Stage Clear Reward System Added[/b]
You now receive rewards each time you clear a map node![/p][p]🐛 [b]Bug Fixes & Optimizations[/b]
Improvements to resolution, input, rhythm bar visibility, and various minor bugs.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p]Come play the [b]cleaner, sharper, more fun Chain Letter demo[/b] now!
And please feel free to share your thoughts or feedback on Twitter or Discord![/p][p]Thanks for playing 💌[/p][p]🔗 Discord: [/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/AGbJXHnQPJ"]https://discord.gg/AGbJXHnQPJ[/url][/p][p]
🔗 Twitter: [/p][p][url="https://x.com/ChainLetter_dev"]https://x.com/ChainLetter_dev[/url][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Intro and Character Art Rework in Progress!
notes.notes:
[p]We’re currently reworking the intro and character art, which we felt were too static and lacked impact.
It seems these elements have had a negative effect on the demo and possibly on the overall game experience as well 😢[/p][p]Once the rework is complete, we’ll be updating the demo with the new content!
We’d truly appreciate your support and wishlist in the meantime.[/p][p]While you’re here, take a peek at the reworked character art in progress! :)[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45676645/27af09540381696f181890e569890285cdcbc000.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45676645/1d0fb616bd2d7658c241edc3b87e6bc8d47ef3e4.png"][/img] The cold and snappy [b]Jamba[/b] has become even more icy. ❄️[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45676645/7bcda428fb7dd8f2c843d5d62f290aa54a748d2f.png"][/img] The gloomy, melancholic [b]Jupi[/b]... might have gotten a [i]bit[/i] brighter?[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45676645/367363bfb126fa0eb404d677f666eb09422c5e4f.png"][/img]And main character [b]Mongsil[/b] is now even more simply cheerful!![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45676645/51b33e825bc547154df914d699add3af28971123.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45676645/5a450f92f7af8c2533da9b1978287058d6ece0c3.png"][/img][/p][p]and additional expressions.....[/p]

notes.title: Several Bugs in the Chain Letter Demo Have Been Fixed!
notes.notes: [p]-Several Bugs in the Chain Letter Demo Have Been Fixed!-[/p][p][/p][p][b]Hello Chain Letter players![/b][/p][p]We've updated the Chain Letter demo based on the feedback we received during the demo period.[/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where tutorial inputs were sometimes not recognized[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an invisible wall bug during the minigame with DevilMongsil[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an input-related bug when opening the info panel on the map[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where re-entering Stage 1 after clearing the boss would make it unplayable[/p][/*][/list][p]We've also addressed several minor but technical input-related bugs.[/p][p]If Steam doesn't update the game automatically, please try restarting Steam.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you so much for playing! :)[/p]

notes.title: [Demo Released] Try Chain Letter's Gameplay Now!
notes.notes:
[p]Hello everyone!ːsteamhappyː[/p][p]
We're excited to share that the [b]demo for [i]Chain Letter[/i][/b] is now officially available on Steam![/p][p]This demo lets you explore the opening part of the story and try out our unique blend of rhythm, defense, and roguelike gameplay.[/p][p]In the demo, you'll:[/p][list][*][p]Meet your first group of classmates and persuade them to join you[/p][/*][*][p]Unlock and test their skills in a rhythm-based battle system[/p][/*][*][p]Play through Stage 1 with full controller & keyboard support[/p][/*][*][p]Experience the core game mechanics and vibe[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p]We're still actively developing the game, so your feedback would mean a lot!
If you enjoy the demo, please consider [b]adding [i]Chain Letter[/i] to your wishlist[/b] and sharing your thoughts.[/p][p]Thank you for playing![/p][p]
 [i]Jarikki Studio[/i][/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3863360/Chain_Letter_Demo/"][/dynamiclink][/p]
